segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, second page's minetn entry) to Mine Town. The seed and character differ from the existing Mine Town loader cases; after arrival, rooms.c check_special_room() calls hack.c in_town() at the hero's location before recording the Mine Town achievement. Blocked: the fresh differential next diverges in makemon.c set_mimic_sym(), where the JavaScript shop-room lookup reaches rn2(17) instead of C's rn2(10); record this case after that function is corrected.
